intervals.label: PETRA data taking
intervals.locator: DESY backgrounder "The discovery of the gluon"; end from Bethke & Wagner (2022), Table 1
intervals.note: Start = January 1979 data-taking (the detector was moved into the beam in October 1978); end = the 3 November 1986 final shutdown of PETRA and its experiments.
intervals.quote: Data-taking started in January 1979 by the detectors MARK J, PLUTO and TASSO.

intervals.label: PETRA shut down; experiment ended
intervals.note: All PETRA experiments ended with the final shutdown of PETRA as a collider.
intervals.quote: final shutdown of PETRA and experiments

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: DESY published no coordinates for the PETRA experimental halls that were fetched; the marker is the DESY campus point. The backgrounder names the South-Eastern hall.
placements.quote: The TASSO detector had its home in PETRA´s South-Eastern experimental hall.

summary.plain: The TASSO particle detector in the south-east experimental hall of DESY's PETRA ring, built to record electron-positron collisions and track the sprays of particles they produce.
summary.technical: TASSO detector at one of the four PETRA collision regions (South-Eastern hall); recorded e⁺e⁻ annihilation at PETRA from January 1979 to November 1986. A published detector description was not retrieved for this record.
